_meta.description: Golden test charts for kundali-qa. Each fixture targets a specific classical scenario (see SKILL.md). Dates are chosen so the chart is expected to produce the flagged pattern. Where the expected flag is not deterministic from date-alone (needs verification with local dev server), it is marked with a null and the check falls back to LLM-output-only inspection.

manglik-uncancelled.name: Aastha
manglik-uncancelled.notes: Sun in Aries early morning → Aries or Taurus lagna typical. Mars in Capricorn (exalted) around Apr 1990 — this actually CANCELS Manglik. Fixture may need date shift; kept as example baseline. Verify with chart panel.

manglik-cancelled-by-jupiter.name: Nikhil
manglik-cancelled-by-jupiter.notes: Chosen so Mars sits in a Manglik house with Jupiter aspecting. Verify Jupiter's aspect from chart output.

cancer-lagna-manglik-exempt.name: Priya
cancer-lagna-manglik-exempt.notes: Early morning August in Chennai → Cancer Ascendant likely (Sun in Leo but Lagna rises hours before Sun). For Cancer lagna, Mars is Yogakaraka; classical rule exempts Cancer/Leo lagna from Manglik regardless of Mars placement.

sade-sati-active-second-phase.name: Rekha
sade-sati-active-second-phase.notes: Moon expected in Gemini/Cancer range for this date. Saturn transiting Pisces/Aries in 2026 → Sade Sati around Aries/Taurus moons. Verify via chart Moon-sign; peak phase depends on exact Saturn transit position vs natal Moon.

strong-gajakesari.name: Ravi
strong-gajakesari.notes: Moon and Jupiter in kendra from each other; sunset time chosen so both are angular. Verify Gajakesari flag from Yogas panel.

debilitated-sun-in-10th.name: Kabir
debilitated-sun-in-10th.notes: Sun in Libra (debilitated Oct 5), 10th house from Cap ascendant would be Libra. Time picked so Capricorn lagna is plausible; verify against chart.

kaal-sarp.name: Isha
kaal-sarp.notes: Fixture reserved for a chart where all 7 non-node planets fall on one side of the Rahu-Ketu axis. Requires ephemeris verification; skip Gate 4 check if axis is not clean.

weak-10th-lord.name: Meera
weak-10th-lord.notes: Chosen to place 10th lord in 8th or 12th (career blockage pattern). Verify against chart's house-lord panel.
